blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled mounted a big comeback in the third set and beat Choco Mucho, 25-23, 23-25, 25-23, 25-17, to stay unbeaten in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday night at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Brooke Van Sickle continued to show her Most Valuable Player numbers with 19 points, 12 digs, and 10 excellent receptions, while MJ Phillips chipped in 13 points off eight kills, three blocks, and two ace, as the duo sparked their impressive rally in the third set.
